SRC-363:R001.text: DRIFT-001 Canonical-Log-Integrity: Direct manual edits to LOG.md strictly proscribed; all event mutations require saipen writer

SRC-363:R002.text: DRIFT-002 Baseline-Identity-Provenance: Surrogate archive or working tree hash must not masquerade as audited baseline identity

SRC-363:R003.text: DRIFT-003 Diagnostic-Attribution-Honesty: Local regressions must not be classified as pre-existing without historical evidence

SRC-363:R004.text: DRIFT-004 Terminal-Disposition-Discipline: Requirements must not remain unresolved or unverified when claiming ticket completion

SRC-363:R005.text: DRIFT-005 Contract-Locator-Precision: Source requirements must cite existing file paths and validated symbol locators

SRC-363:R006.text: DRIFT-006 Pipeline-Exit-Observability: Shell pipelines must not mask non-zero failure exit codes via downstream commands

SRC-363:R007.text: DRIFT-007 Loop-Detection-and-No-Progress: Scheduler must detect repeated identical verification attempts without durable delta

SRC-363:R008.text: DRIFT-008 Response-Presentation-Discipline: Machine digest contract and style rules must suppress identity narration spam
